candidates.name: Endometriosis
support_spans: a subcutaneous mass in the lower-left abdominal region
The mass was accompanied by slight pain that worsened around menstruation
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and history suggest a possible case of endometriosis, given the location and menstrual-related pain of the mass.

candidates.name: Abdominal wall endometrioma
support_spans: a subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium
The nodule's surface was normal, without ulceration or bleeding
candidates.why: The presence of a subcutaneous nodule with a well-defined border and the patient's history of myomectomy and cesarean section increase the likelihood of abdominal wall endometrioma.

candidates.name: Endometriosis
support_spans: The mass was accompanied by slight pain that worsened around menstruation
candidates.why: The worsening of pain around menstruation suggests a possible hormonal influence on the growth and activity of endometrial tissue, which is a characteristic of endometriosis.

candidates.name: Adenomyosis
support_spans: a history of myomectomy to remove a myoma six months ago
candidates.why: The patient's history of myomectomy and the presence of a subcutaneous mass may be related to adenomyosis, which can cause similar symptoms and is often associated with endometriosis.

candidates.name: Endometriosis
support_spans: Histopathology: Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
candidates.why: The histopathological findings of endometrial glands and stroma in the subcutaneous tissue are diagnostic of endometriosis.

candidates.name: Abdominal wall endometrioma
support_spans: Ultrasonography: Showed a hybrid echo-mass about 1.1 × 1.0 cm, with an irregular shape, well-defined border, located 3 mm from the body surface in the subcutaneous soft tissue
candidates.why: The ultrasonographic findings of a well-defined mass with an irregular shape in the subcutaneous tissue are consistent with an abdominal wall endometrioma.
